title: Zero decimal places formatting in data visualization
answers: Why does setting decimal places to 0 not round numbers in SQL insights or tables?
How are 0 decimal places formatted under style None in data visualization?
Why do Big numbers or table cells still show fractions after setting decimal places to 0?
body:
Symptom: Setting Decimal places to 0 on a SQL insight has no effect under style None, displaying raw float values like 42.195 instead of 42.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:formatDataWithSettings and table cell formatting in frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:dataVisualizationLogic checked decimalPlaces for truthiness, treating 0 as falsy.
Fix pattern: Compare decimalPlaces != null rather than checking truthiness so explicit 0 values are preserved.
Constraints: Applies when formatting numbers under styles like None or custom precision; does not apply under short style, where table cells ignore decimalPlaces.
applies: Number formatting with style None or explicit decimal places in data visualization.
